nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
Pending owner staged by transferOwnership and promoted by acceptOwnership.
Public token name string, set to ElChapoDoge in the constructor.
Public token symbol string, set to CHAPO in the constructor.
Public token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Fixed total token supply, set once in the constructor.
Mapping of account address to token balance.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved allowance.
Caller-supplied msg.sender used as balance key, allowance key, owner check and callback argument.
SafeMath.safeAdd, public pure addition with overflow require.
SafeMath.safeSub, public pure subtraction with underflow require.
SafeMath.safeMul, public pure multiplication with overflow require.
SafeMath.safeDiv, public pure division with non-zero divisor require.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function staging a new pending owner in newOwner.
Promotes newOwner to owner after checking msg.sender == newOwner.
Token constructor setting metadata, supply and crediting the fixed deployer address.
Returns _totalSupply minus the zero-address balance.
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Moves tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeAdd/safeSub.
Writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
Moves tokens from an arbitrary from address consuming the caller allowance.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on the untrusted spender contract.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting ETH.
onlyOwner function performing an external transfer call on a user-supplied token address.
Arithmetic c = a + b in safeAdd guarded by require(c >= a).
Arithmetic c = a - b in safeSub guarded by require(b <= a).
Arithmetic c = a * b in safeMul guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Arithmetic c = a / b in safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0).
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) on an attacker-controlled contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on a user-supplied token contract.

edges.reason: The Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, giving the caller permanent privileged control.
The onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before staging newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before ownership is transferred.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] with the caller-controlled amount.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callee.
onlyOwner restricts the arbitrary ERC20 sweep to the contract owner.
msg.sender is passed as the from argument into the untrusted receiveApproval callback.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply minus the zero-address balance.
balances[address(0)] is read and subtracted from the reported supply.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
transfer writes the sender and recipient balances through safeSub/safeAdd.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom updates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed initial supply.
Constructor credits the entire supply to the hardcoded deployer address.
Constructor sets the token name string.
Constructor sets the token symbol string.
Constructor sets the decimals value.
Owned constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership stages the pending owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner as the caller authorisation source.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
safeAdd body executes c = a + b guarded by require(c >= a).
safeSub body executes c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
safeMul body executes c = a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
safeDiv body executes c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
totalSupply performs an unguarded subtraction of the zero-address balance from _totalSupply.
transfer calls safeSub for the msg.sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd for the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the from balance and the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an arbitrary spender contract before returning.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external call into a user-supplied token contract.
The untrusted spender contract re-enters the token through receiveApproval while approveAndCall state is still settling.
